newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: Air NZ acquires control of Jetset.
newsitem.headline: Air NZ acquires control of Jetset.

text.p: Air New Zealand Ltd said on Thursday it had reached agreement to acquire the 50 percent of Jetset Travel and Technology that it did not already own.
The acquisition is subject to Australian regulatory consent.
The Jetset Group has a gross turnover of more than A$1 billion annually, Air NZ said in a statement.
Jetset was founded by Isi Leibler and Air NZ became a 50 percent shareholder in 1985.

Air NZ managing director Jim McCrea said the latest move was a logical step which would strengthen Jetset and pave the way for further enhancement of its services to the travel agency system and airline suppliers.
